item.title: Armed man arrested for allegedly charging at Democratic Ohio governor candidate
item.description: The suspect "aggressively shoved his way through the crowd" toward Amy Acton, Mahoning County Sheriff Jerry Greene told CBS News.

item.title: Ross Fire still burning, with over 90,000 acres scorched
item.description: The wildfire, which has torn through Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forced evacuations, closed roads and disrupted schools.

item.title: At least 5 dead in Amazon cargo plane crash at Miami airport
item.description: An Amazon cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport and struck several vehicles, killing at least five and injuring five others, officials said.

item.title: Far-right AfD wins big in German regional election, falls short of majority
item.description: Alternative for Germany failed to secure an absolute majority in the state legislature to govern alone and overcome the so-called firewall of mainstream parties' refusal to work with AfD.

item.title: Indonesia volcano eruptions cancels hundreds of flights at major airport hub
item.description: By Sunday evening, the closure of eight airports had affected 170,000 passengers from 1,558 canceled flights, including 963 flights in Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta airport alone.

item.title: Crews working to restore power to thousands in Michigan after storms
item.description: DTE Energy says around 4,000 utility workers were focused on restoring power to thousands of Southeast Michigan residents on Saturday and Sunday.

item.title: Iran threatens "more painful" retaliation after U.S. strikes Iranian oil tankers
item.description: Iran on Sunday threatened a "more painful" response to U.S. strikes on three Iranian oil tankers.

item.title: Armed man arrested after charging at Ohio governor candidate Amy Acton
item.description: An armed man was arrested after charging toward the Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, Amy Acton, on Sunday during a campaign stop at the Canfield Fair, injuring several people, campaign officials said.

item.title: Millions mark end of summer at "The Great Minnesota Get-Together"
item.description: Jonah Kaplan is at one of the biggest state fairs in the country to show us why so many are drawn to some old-fashioned fun in the digital age.

item.title: 25 years after 9/11 began America's longest war, the Taliban is back in control
item.description: Twenty-five years after 9/11 began America's longest war, and five years after it ended, the Taliban is firmly back in control in Afghanistan. Imtiaz Tyab in Kabul with a look back on America's longest war.

item.title: Connecticut school honors Sept. 11 attacks victim through education
item.description: The Adam J. Lewis Academy in Bridgeport, Connecticut, is a living tribute to principal Patty Lewis' husband, who died in the Sept. 11 attacks on the World Trade Center. "CBS Weekend News" producer Caroline Lewis reports on her dad's legacy 25 years after the terrorist attacks.

item.title: Trump administration makes another Supreme Court appeal on mail ballot fight
item.description: The filing comes after a U.S. District Court judge extended an order against the Postal Service enforcing President Trump's executive order for the November elections.

item.title: Trump administration appeals to Supreme Court again to restrict mail ballots
item.description: The Trump administration has again asked the Supreme Court to intervene in its push to restrict mail ballots ahead of the midterm elections. Taurean Small, who is in Bridgewater, New Jersey, traveling with the president, has the updates.

item.title: USS Lincoln heads home as war with Iran escalates
item.description: Nearly 5,000 troops aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln are finally heading home after nearly 300 days of deployment. Meanwhile, fighting amplified in the Gulf region over the weekend as the U.S. and Iran traded attacks. Tom Hanson has the details.

item.title: Labor Day weekend gas prices hit record high
item.description: Labor Day weekend gas prices have never been higher, and Californians are feeling the sticker shock more than most in the U.S., as prices regularly top $6 per gallon. Mark Strassmann is in Los Angeles with the latest.

item.title: Amazon cargo jet runs off Miami airport runway, crashes into multiple vehicles
item.description: Emergency crews rushed into action on Sunday after an Amazon cargo jet ran off the runway in Miami. At least five people were killed. Lindsey Reiser reports on what we know so far.

item.title: How Seth Meyers got to "SNL" via Amsterdam
item.description: Seth Meyers said the Dutch improv theater Boom Chicago gave him and his comedy partner Jill Benjamin a "road map" to create a show that eventually got the attention of "Saturday Night Live."

item.title: The house that unlocked a family's history
item.description: Fred Miller purchased a property to host family gatherings, only to learn it was once a plantation where his ancestors were enslaved.

item.title: Amsterdam improv theater Boom Chicago churns out American comedy legends
item.description: Some of the biggest American comics have gotten their starts at Boom Chicago, an Amsterdam improv theater. Seth Meyers, Jordan Peele, Amber Ruffin and Jason Sudeikis have all cracked jokes there.

item.title: Man unknowingly buys former plantation house where his ancestors were enslaved
item.description: An Air Force veteran wanted a new house for large family gatherings; he ended up getting an incredible link to his family's past.

item.title: 9/6: CBS Weekend News
item.description: An Amazon cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport and struck several vehicles, killing at least five people. Gas prices rise for Labor Day weekend.

item.title: Exit polls put German far-right party ahead in regional election
item.description: AfD Saxony-Anhalt is a racist extremist group, according to the German state's intelligence agency. The party may well trounce its rivals in this weekend's state election.

item.title: Rep. Crow says Congress hasn't been briefed on Hegseth leak investigation
item.description: Democratic Rep. Jason Crow said neither he nor his colleagues in Congress have received "any information" about Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's sweeping leak investigation.

item.title: GOP conference chair says Miller is "our nominee right now" despite allegations
item.description: House Republican Conference Chair Lisa McClain said she is supporting Rep. Max Miller's reelection bid for a third term because "I will support anyone with an R behind their name."

item.title: Former Cuban President Raúl Castro appears publicly after hospitalization
item.description: Former Cuban President Raúl Castro has reappeared in public at a military event celebrating an army branch's anniversary.

item.title: UN endorses new map that shows Africa's size more accurately
item.description: Africa has long been represented as smaller than its real size in maps, which are largely based on an ancient projection.

item.title: Guyana latest "third country" to accept migrants deported from U.S.
item.description: Guyana is one of more than 30 nations that have now signed deals with the Trump administration as part of President Trump's crackdown on illegal immigration.
